attr.alt: Dr. Nahlah — Implants and Prosthodontics Specialists
A patient arranging payment at the practice

nodes.v: Nobody can price an implant case from a phone call, and any practice that does is pricing something other than your mouth. Here is what actually moves the number — and the three ways patients pay for it.
By the practice, on your behalf
All five come out of the consultation and the 3D scan. None of them can be guessed at over the phone.

One tooth, a span, or an entire arch. The jump from several implants to a full arch on four is not linear — four posts carrying an arch is usually more cost-effective than replacing each tooth individually.
How long they have been missing
Bone recedes where teeth are not loading it. Time gone is the single biggest predictor of whether anything has to be rebuilt before an implant can be placed.
Extractions, bone grafting, sinus work. These are separate procedures with their own healing time, and they are the usual reason one quote is months and thousands apart from another.
A zirconia fixed prosthesis is not the same object as an acrylic one, and does not cost the same. What is being quoted matters as much as how many implants.
Surgery, restoration and the laboratory under one roof removes the margin each outside party adds — and the second set of appointments that comes with them.
Second opinions on implant surgery are free here. Bring the treatment plan and the scan, and you will get a straight read on what is in it.
The cheapest option on day one is rarely the cheapest option.

are the lowest number at the start. They are also not a long-term solution: they rest on gum tissue, they move, they need relining and replacing, and the bone underneath keeps receding because nothing is loading it.
sit in the middle. The denture clips onto implants, which stops the movement and puts load back into the bone, while keeping the prosthesis removable.

are the highest number up front and the lowest maintenance afterwards — a fixed bridge on four or more implants, with no relining, no adhesive and no nightly removal. Over a lifetime, that difference compounds.
An implant case is best read as an investment with a maintenance curve, not a purchase. Ask any practice quoting you what the ten-year cost looks like, not just the day-one one.

attr.alt: Discussing a treatment plan and its cost

nodes.v: Most dental PPO plans are accepted. Coverage for implants is often limited, but limited is not nothing — the practice files the claims on your behalf and works the plan for every benefit it actually entitles you to.
Three lenders, for three different situations.
Monthly payment plans through partners the practice already works with. Apply directly with any of them.
Flexible monthly payment options for patients who qualify. Manage the treatment cost over a term instead of in one payment.
Built for lower credit scores. No-collateral loans up to
Apply from a phone in minutes, choose the rate, term and payment that fit, and have funds sent to your account for a lower APR.
Why is there no price list on this page?

Because an honest one cannot exist. Two people missing the same tooth can need entirely different treatment depending on how long it has been gone and what the bone is doing. You get a real number after the scan, in writing, at the consultation.

Some plans offer limited coverage. The practice files claims on your behalf and works to get every benefit your plan entitles you to. Whether that is a large or small share depends entirely on the plan.
Can I finance the whole case?

In most cases yes, through CareCredit, Proceed Finance or LendingClub. Proceed Finance in particular is designed for patients whose credit score would rule out conventional lending, with terms up to 96 months.
Is a second opinion really free?
Yes, on implant surgery. If you have been quoted elsewhere, bring the plan and any imaging.
What an implant is, and the four ways it gets used.
Why four posts can be cheaper than replacing each tooth.
Two offices, four numbers, and the scan that ends the guessing.
Get a number that means something.
The consultation includes the 3D scan, the plan, and the cost of that plan — before you commit to anything.
Implant dentistry and prosthodontics for Northern Virginia — rebuilding smiles that other practices call too complex.
